title: Component Docs Playbook: Deprecations, Usage Recipes, and Migration Paths
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a comprehensive playbook for component-level documentation across tokens, buttons, tables, and charts. Emphasis on clear do/don't guidance, concise API surfaces, migration steps for deprecated props/tokens, and lightweight examples that engineers can copy into PRs. The playbook will be used by designers and frontend engineers to author consistent docs moving forward.
background: Recent component churn (token renames, chart prop normalization, table pagination API changes) produced scattered migration notes and inconsistent examples across the docs site. This ticket consolidates a repeatable authoring pattern so future changes are discoverable and migrations are low-friction.
scope: Deliver a single canonical playbook page plus per-component templated doc snippets for: design tokens (semantic tokens + theming), button variants and loading states, accessible tables (pagination, virtualization), and chart primitives (data contract, axis config, color tokens). Excludes full component redesigns and implementation work beyond copy/examples.
deliverables: Playbook page: 'Authoring component docs at Redwood' (guidelines + examples)
Four templated component doc snippets (tokens, buttons, tables, charts) to paste into the docs site
Migration checklist and codemod links for known breaking changes
Review checklist and QA steps for docs reviewers
Short howto for contributing a new component doc (PR template + lint checks)
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published under /docs/design-system/playbook and linked from component index
Each template includes: short description, props table, code sandboxable example, do/don't list, migration note (if applicable)
At least one engineer and one PM review and sign-off recorded in comments
Migration checklist includes step-by-step upgrade path and links to codemod or sample PRs
Docs lint runs clean for new pages and automated link checks pass
design_examples: Button snippet: minimal primary/secondary/ghost examples plus aria-loading pattern (example code block follows)
Table snippet: pagination + row virtualization example with notes about data shape and keys
Chart snippet: bar chart data contract, sample color tokens usage, and accessibility checklist
Tokens snippet: before/after mapping table for renamed tokens and recommended aliases
migration_notes: Token renames (v2): map old semantic tokens to new tokens; add temporary CSS variables in a deprecation shim
Table API change: 'pageSize' -> 'perPage' migration codemod available in github.com/redwood/codemods#perpage
Chart axis config: prefer 'scale: "linear"|"log"' instead of boolean 'isLogScale' — add adapter function in migration guide
Buttons: legacy 'isPrimary: boolean' prop deprecated, use 'variant="primary"|"secondary"|"ghost"'
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Publish playbook and templates (this ticket). Phase 2: Outreach - announce on #design-system and schedule a short walkthrough with frontend guild. Phase 3: Linkify migration notes in component deprecation notices and add codemod usage to release notes.
